parsedVerdict.reasoning: The module is the infrastructure (adapter) layer. Its files serve one concern: connecting the application's use cases to the outside world. The in-memory repositories implement the domain repository interfaces. UuidGenerator implements the application's IdGenerator interface. The controllers and errorHandler are the HTTP adapters. compositionRoot.ts, app.ts and server.ts do the wiring. Each rule lives in one place: request-body parsing in requestValues.ts (used by all three controllers), the error-code-to-HTTP-status mapping in errorHandler.ts, use-case construction in buildUseCases, and routing in createApp. The controllers call use cases rather than repositories, so they do not bypass the module's abstractions. One small inconsistency: TaskController reads path parameters with String(req.params.x) instead of a helper. These values always exist on a matched route, so this is not a meaningful bypass or duplicated rule.
